mobile.source_history_role: legacy history only; not a Production deployment source

operating_rules: Keep PC and Mobile on separate Vercel projects.
PC Production Root Directory is apps/pc; Mobile Production Root Directory is apps/mobile.
Keep outside-root source access enabled for both projects so packages/common is available during builds.
Shared runtime source lives only in packages/common and is staged from the app-specific runtime manifests.
Do not restore raw GitHub runtime rewrites or a second tracked common copy under either app.
Treat vivizac/mobile as legacy source history only unless an explicit rollback plan says otherwise.
